turns.input: Mira Thorne gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration: Mira Thorne pulls the worn leather boots from her shoulder bag with a sigh of mild irritation, examining them briefly before extending them toward Nicco. "Here. They're decent enough, barely used. Found them in a lot I bought last season and they've sat in my back room since." She doesn't wait for thanks or explanation, simply pressing the footwear into his hands with the brisk efficiency of someone who dislikes loose ends. The plant stains on her fingertips leave faint smudges on the leather as she withdraws, and she immediately turns to scan the square with the restless attention of someone who never quite stops working.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
Nicco thanks her, then extends the boots back toward Mira. "You'll need them more than me."

Mira's fingers pause halfway to accepting them. She looks at the boots, then at him, copper-brown brows drawing together slightly. "I have several pairs. These were surplus." She does not take them immediately, studying his face with the same assessing quality she brings to unknown herbs—neither offended nor pleased, simply considering. "You came out here in what, soft house shoes? The streets are worse than they look."

She waits, hands still at her sides, plant-stained and patient. A cart rattles past somewhere in the square's moderate traffic, and she glances toward the sound without turning her head fully away from him. "Keep them or don't. But if you're walking Calderan without proper footwear, you'll learn why the physicians stay busy."
